annotations.title: Korean relative date to calendar date

description: Turn a Korean relative date expression into an exact date and weekday, counted from a base date in Korea time: 오늘/내일/모레/내일모레/글피, 어제/그제, "3일 뒤", "이틀 후", "2주 후", "한 달 뒤", "3영업일 후", "다음 주 화요일", "지난주 금요일", "이번 주말", "금요일", "다음 달 말일", "이번 달 25일", "내년 3월 1일", "연말". Weeks start on Monday. Also says whether the result is a Korean business day. Use this instead of working out weekdays yourself.

base_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for today in Korea (KST).
